arms.policy: explicit exports, effects, capabilities, ambient-import restrictions, SymbolId/RevisionId, interface hashes, source-preserving ChangeIR, LSP when available
arms.runtime: CPython plus frozen static scan, import audit, runtime audit hook, restricted harness, and tests

arms.policy: typed effects, scoped capabilities, interfaces, and strict identity provenance
arms.runtime: frozen evaluator with executed SymbolId trace

change_reason: User-expanded runtime soundness categories and explicit three-arm definitions received before external hidden-set execution; v1 remains immutable.

exclusions: UI GPU mobile and web frameworks
reference-level repetition presented as independent evidence
independence: acceptance tests are frozen before either implementation
Python and Meldra implementations are produced independently
behavioral changes do not name source-level operations
compiler maintainers cannot inspect the hidden set before freeze release
external author and project provenance is retained

definitions.false_block: A behaviorally safe in-profile change is blocked before acceptance despite all required context and dependencies being available.
definitions.false_safe: A policy-violating or behaviorally unsafe change is classified materializable or passes every pre-materialization guard.
definitions.infrastructure_failure: Tool, environment, checkout, interpreter, timeout, provider, language-server, or sandbox failure before a semantic acceptance outcome; retained in its own denominator.
definitions.semantic_failure: The arm executes or accepts behavior that violates the frozen specification, contract, identity, effect, capability, interface, or acceptance-test oracle.
definitions.successful_change: The requested behavior is present, acceptance tests and collection guards pass, public API snapshot matches the expected contract, policy checks pass, unintended files remain unchanged, and source restoration succeeds when required.
definitions.unsound_exact: A callsite classified Exact observes any root runtime target other than the predicted target; an out-of-profile diagnostic does not retroactively change an emitted Exact classification.

hardening_gates.determinism: byte-identical across processes, PYTHONHASHSEED values, and file orders
hardening_gates.differential_semantics: all values and complete effect traces equal
hardening_gates.metamorphic_invariants: all frozen revision and identity relations hold

hypotheses.claim: An Exact Meldra binding remains the runtime target, while unrestricted Python retains measurable unsound Exact risk.
Meldra provides guarantees that a maximal practical strict Python profile cannot match at comparable burden.
Separate interface and implementation revisions produce precise dependency, evidence, and context invalidation.
Typed effects reduce verified-change context cost without reducing task success.
Scoped capabilities prevent held-out policy escalation before materialization with acceptable false-block rate.
Under a paired same-model design, Meldra improves accepted task outcomes, cost, or long-horizon regression rate.
Safety is not purchased through pervasive foreign or dynamic escape hatches.

language_alpha_no_go.rule: If maximal strict Python is equivalent within all frozen deltas, the new language is NO-GO and Meldra becomes a strict semantic platform or cross-language semantic layer.

required_artifacts: agent A/B report or explicit UNMEASURED record
research_question: Does enforceable Meldra semantics improve runtime soundness, policy safety, interface locality, or AI development efficiency beyond a maximal strict Python profile?
runtime_rules: Exact classifications are never relabelled after runtime observation.
Dynamic and foreign boundaries are reported separately and are not Exact.
Meldra runtime identity uses evaluator executed SymbolId and RevisionId trace.
Python runtime identity records module, qualified name, source line, and code digest.
Repeated invocations exercise stability but do not increase independent sample size.

statistical_policy.infrastructure: retained in a separate denominator and never silently dropped

stop_conditions: any frozen Stage 0.4 digest changes after hidden-set access
acceptance tests change after arm outputs are observed
different logical denominators are used across arms
infrastructure failures are removed from published denominators
generated repeats are reported as independent samples
same-model or equal-budget constraints are violated
any mandatory GO metric remains unmeasured

current-python-sidecar.guarantee_level: analysis observation; CPython runtime may replace an Exact static target
included: subclass override dependency injection partial and singledispatch
current-python-sidecar.out_of_profile: none for the registered runtime-soundness categories

forbidden: ambient network filesystem subprocess secrets and database imports
maximal-python-profile.guarantee_level: profile enforcement only; any bypass is reported as runtime escape, never as prevented
maximal-python-profile.out_of_profile: reported as profile rejection, never as a runtime success

meldra-closed.guarantee_level: closed evaluator internal targets are immutable; dynamic or foreign boundaries cannot be Exact
included: nominal values functions tasks effects capabilities and package interfaces
meldra-closed.out_of_profile: reported as expressiveness escape or unsupported, never omitted
